epistemic_gaps: The authors noted substantial individual variation in response to caffeine, meaning the average effect may not apply equally to all individuals.
primary_claim: A moderate dose of 3 to 6 mg per kilogram of body mass of caffeine, taken about 60 minutes before exercise, improved time-trial completion time by roughly 2 percent and mean power output by about 3 percent in aerobic endurance events such as cycling and distance running.
